Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 44

“We have heard, Janardana, that a lasting dwelling in hell awaits those whose family duties have been destroyed.”

Note anushushruma — we have heard. Arjuna shifts from his own reasoning to inherited authority, borrowing the weight of tradition just as his own argument reaches its limit.
